title: Lolth's Candle

sources.title: Vitriol of Lolth's Candle
markers: | description = '''Vitriol of Lolth's Candle''' is an [[Alchemy|Alchemical Extraction]]. It can be combined with any [[Alchemy#Extractions|Ash]] to create {{SmRarityItem|Malice}}.

sources.title: Malice
markers: | description = {{rare|Malice}} is a [[Consumables|Consumable]] ([[Coatings|Coating]]). It can be applied to a weapon to give it special properties for ten turns or [[throw|thrown]] as a [[Grenades|Grenade]] to inflict its effects in an area.

summary: Combine three Lolth’s Candles into Vitriol of Lolth’s Candle, then mix it with any Ashes to brew Malice.

fields.Use: Combine three Lolth’s Candles into Vitriol of Lolth’s Candle, then mix it with any Ashes to brew Malice.
fields.Base value: 25 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
